_doc: Gaon Guard AI - Antigravity Workplan - Google Antigravity Hackathon Challenge 3

objective.title: Gaon Guard AI: 3-Engine Agentic Crisis Intelligence for Rural Pakistan
objective.summary: Build an AI-native crisis response system that fuses real-time signals (weather, health, road, missing persons) into actionable dispatch decisions for flood-affected rural communities in Sindh and Punjab. The system uses 3 cooperating agent engines to triage crises, coordinate field response, and audit aid distribution -- all with full explainability traces.
objective.primary_demo_scenario: Ali Pur (Larkana, Sindh) flood crisis with missing child and health outbreak

engines.name: Crisis Intelligence Engine
engines.description: Detects, verifies, and scores crisis events from multi-source signals

engines.name: Response Coordination Engine
engines.description: Dispatches field teams, tracks missing persons, manages real-time field operations

engines.name: Aid Audit Engine
engines.description: Monitors aid distribution for anomalies, price gouging, and fraud patterns

architecture.execution_detail: Engine 1 (Group A) runs first as the trigger. Once a crisis is created and scored, Engine 2 (Group B) and Engine 3 (Group C) can execute in parallel. Within each group, agents run sequentially: A1 -> A2 -> A3, B1 -> B2 -> B3, C1 -> C2 -> C3.

A1_INTAKE.name: Intake Agent
A1_INTAKE.purpose: Parse raw complaint in Urdu/Roman Urdu/English, extract structured crisis signals

A2_EVIDENCE.name: Evidence Agent
A2_EVIDENCE.purpose: Cross-check signals against 5 data sources, produce confidence score
A2_EVIDENCE.input: A1 output + API data from weather, roads, health, villages, missing persons

A3_SEVERITY.name: Severity Agent
A3_SEVERITY.purpose: Apply weighted scoring, authorize or hold dispatch

B1_DISPATCH.name: Dispatch Agent
B1_DISPATCH.purpose: Match available teams to crisis, create dispatch tickets

B2_MISSING_MATCH.name: Missing Persons Matching Agent
B2_MISSING_MATCH.purpose: Cross-reference missing person reports with camp registrations
B2_MISSING_MATCH.input: Missing persons list + unidentified camp registrations

B3_FIELD_MONITOR.name: Field Monitor Agent
B3_FIELD_MONITOR.purpose: Track dispatch progress, send reminders, escalate stale tickets

C1_DISTRIBUTION_AUDIT.name: Distribution Audit Agent
C1_DISTRIBUTION_AUDIT.purpose: Verify aid distribution records against entitlements and GPS

C2_PRICE_MONITOR.name: Price Monitor Agent
C2_PRICE_MONITOR.purpose: Compare market prices against government guidelines, flag gouging

C3_PATTERN_DETECTOR.name: Pattern Detector Agent
C3_PATTERN_DETECTOR.purpose: Detect systematic fraud patterns across distribution logs
C3_PATTERN_DETECTOR.output: Pattern analysis and fraud risk assessment

success_criteria.description: Engine 1 (A1-A3) correctly triages the Ali Pur demo complaint from raw text to scored crisis event
Engine 2 (B1-B3) dispatches correct teams, matches Hassan Ali to CAMP_REG_019, sends family alert
success_criteria.metric: match_score > 0.8, team dispatched within 30s of crisis activation

success_criteria.description: Engine 3 (C1-C3) detects at least one anomaly in aid distribution or price gouging scenario
success_criteria.metric: audit_status != PASS for flagged test case

success_criteria.description: Full agent trace is recorded for every decision with explainable reasoning
success_criteria.metric: agent_traces collection has entries for every agent step

success_criteria.description: End-to-end demo completes within 60 seconds from complaint to dispatch
All data is clearly marked as SYNTHETIC throughout the system
success_criteria.metric: X-Data-Type: SYNTHETIC header on all API responses

5. B1 dispatches PDMA + Health teams -> dispatch tickets created
